script.text: Yubel attempted to use Super Polymerization to fuse all the worlds together.
Now I activate Super Polymerization! With its power, I will break the boundaries of time and space and unite the twelve dimensions!
When the twelve dimensions become one, the ensuing explosion will create a new world, one where only you and I shall exist!
HAHAHAHAHA! I've done it! By destroying your reality, I've won! You and I will finally be together forever!
Super Polymerization isn't fusing any dimensions. I can't let that happen.
Instead, it’s going to fuse us.
Yubel, I get it. You started out with good intentions, but you lost your way. You've been alone.
But you're not going to be alone anymore, Yubel. I'll help you find the right path again.
Together, we will fight as one!
After Jaden and Yubel's duel, Duel Academy was returned to Earth safely, along with all the students. However, no one knew where Jaden and Yubel had gone or whether they would ever see them again.
